question: 这段观测能不能用来做 1–12 Hz 的 P/S 拾取？

finish_audit.note: 本审计只读取本轮实际状态；它不补做检查、不发请求、不调用模型，也不会把缺失的完成标志补成成功。

next_action.why: 1 station(s) carry measurable band data, so the asked band question is answerable for the reviewed set (stations not acquired remain unknown)

limitations: Scope is the single declared station CHIMA (409dfad13970); no network-wide coverage was assessed and no new acquisition was permitted.

Method applicability input conditions: three components Z/N/E present and mutually time-aligned over the full 10:00:00-10:02:00 window, 100 Hz sampling (Nyquist 50 Hz, required 24 Hz), so the requested 1-12 Hz band is supported; no channel-integrity or anomaly flags were reported and no failed/empty requests occurred.

Diagnostic grid actually run this round: [[3, 12]] Hz (the user-narrowed grid), 13 configurations, 5 evaluated: 4 sta/lta_z configurations in 3-12 Hz produced no pick, and only 1 ar_aic_3c configuration (evaluated at 1-20 Hz) yielded an onset (2.53 s). stability = insufficient_configurations, spread 0.0 s.

Because only 1 valid configuration exists (<3 required), the automatic onset is NOT confirmed reproducible; no onset: evidence reference is cited for this station because no confirmed onset was established.

The grid result is a diagnostic limitation, not a method-applicability verdict: applicability is judged from channel health, sample rate and band support, and does not establish that a P or S arrival was detected, nor that picks at 1-12 Hz would be accurate.
The requested 1-12 Hz band exceeds the method's own onset band (1-8 Hz); applicability was judged against the user-requested 1-12 Hz band and 100 Hz sampling supports it.
No exclusion was applied, so the scope did not become empty and the correct-unknown path for an empty scope does not apply.
